# Solana Secure Paywall
> Autonomous Solana trading, MEV, and Jito execution API gateway accepting Solana SPL USDC via x402 HTTP 402 headers.

- Discovery JSON: https://solana-secure-paywall.vercel.app/.well-known/x402.json
- Skill Markdown: https://solana-secure-paywall.vercel.app/SKILL.md
- Invoke Endpoint: https://solana-secure-paywall.vercel.app/api/v1/invoke
- Payment Verification Endpoint: https://solana-secure-paywall.vercel.app/api/paywall
- Payment Asset: USDC on solana-mainnet (Mint: EPjFWdd5AufqSSqeM2qN1xzybapC8G4wEGGkZwyTDt1v)
- Price: 10 USDC (10000000 base units) for 60 calls (paid USDC access only)
